flaws.description: Replaced the left y-axis label 'Impact Score (Positive/Negative)' with 'Debt-to-GDP Ratio (%)' to mislabel the primary axis quantity.
Swapped 'Low' and 'High' in the hue_order list of the boxplot to mislabel the risk levels in the legend.
Changed the line color for Avg Debt-to-GDP Ratio from '#45B7D1' (blue) to '#FF5733' (orange).
